query: INSERT INTO billing_subscription (org_id, provider, provider_subscription_id, provider_customer_id, provider_price_id, status, current_period_end, occurred_at, updated_at) VALUES ($1, 'stripe', $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8) ON CONFLICT (org_id) DO UPDATE SET provider = EXCLUDED.provider, provider_subscription_id = EXCLUDED.provider_subscription_id, provider_customer_id = EXCLUDED.provider_customer_id, provider_price_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.provider_price_id, billing_subscription.provider_price_id), status = EXCLUDED.status, current_period_end = EXCLUDED.current_period_end, occurred_at = EXCLUDED.occurred_at, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at WHERE EXCLUDED.occurred_at >= billing_subscription.occurred_at
